column1: # Telex tone keys with the old tone style. Only `oa`, `oe` and `uy` open syllables
# differ (spec §3.4 rule 4): the mark sits on the second vowel, `hoà` rather than
# `hòa`. Everything else in this file is a counter-example that must not move.
# Closed syllables keep the last nucleus vowel under both styles.
# Counter-examples: these open pairs keep their first vowel under both styles.
# `qu` and `gi` onsets are unaffected by the style.
